name: 随身条包电解质冲饮速溶款
description: 外盒与独立条包成套，撕袋倒水即冲即饮的高对比深色视觉

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF packshot stage alternating with a deep charcoal #17181A graphic field and one berry-pink #F07C85 infographic field, one full-height accent bar per dark screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright high-key front-left softbox key with a fill card, thin sweeping rim along sachet edges on dark fields, skimming texture light only on macro, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte charcoal board #17181A, pale matte concrete #CFC7BE, low blank display tray on seamless white #FFFFFF, loose granule scatter as the only surface texture
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in heavy uppercase display scale, in-image copy carried only by placeholders, never dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line circular glyphs in one accent color, empty seal outlines, no filled pictograms and no cert or flag artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 or clean side-profile sachet angle and scale across the set, tear notch always readable, every parameter row rendered as a blank plate instead of a number
noDrift: no legible words, numbers or badges drawn in-frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold high-contrast electrolyte drink-mix commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, deep charcoal #17181A, berry-pink accent #F07C85 and graphite text #33383D; bright high-key front-left softbox key with fill card, thin sweeping rim on dark fields and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in heavy uppercase; single-weight thin-line circular icon style with empty seal outlines; clean commercial food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable sachet angle and scale with blank label plates replacing every numeral; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 6 张源主图逐图事实：图1 纯白底，外盒三四角立放与一条竖立条包并置，盒面三行参数条与斜置圆形标识位；图2 深色底，左侧竖排口味字样色带、中部成分表、右侧五枚圆形线性图标列、底部一句主张条；图3 斜切分栏，左为作业者侧身举杯畅饮、右上粗盐晶飞散、右侧三段主张文字位；图4 深色底，开盖陈列盒内成排条包、前方一条平放并撒出粉粒；图5 强调色底高对比图解屏，顶部深色标题带加空白方块符号与回环箭头；图6 深色底，手撕条包向广口杯倒粒，左侧叠加杯型剖面与三行液位刻度。品类判定：产品为需冲水饮用的粉剂独立条包，形态属冲调而非即饮瓶装饮料，也非片剂胶囊类补充剂，故归「食品饮料／冲调」；源场景以高温重体力作业与随身补水为主，未出现运动即饮瓶型，故不改挂饮料或运动户外（源类目路径仅作线索，以图为准）。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与系列名、包装装面配色与斜置圆形标、成分表全部数值与毫克数、成分原文、产地与旗帜标识、专家推荐与科研配方类断言、功效与适口主张原句、平台徽章与星级、模特身份与面容（改为侧身裁切脸部的通用成年模特）；所有数值与资质位改为空白参数行、空表格单元、空印章框与无读数留空指示条；产品一律以 {product} 占位，图内文案一律以 {selling_point_n} 与 {callout_n} 占位。
